title: Pair Creation on Quintessence-Dressed Nariai and Bertotti–Robinson Throats: Chart Independence and Adiabatic Vacua
content: Degenerate horizons of black holes surrounded by a Kiselev quintessence fluid open into two product throats: a Nariai region dS2 × S2$ when the black-hole and cosmological horizons merge, and a Bertotti–Robinson region AdS2 × S2 when the charged hole becomes extremal. We study a scalar field on both throats in a family of time-dependent charts whose conformal factor is a difference of Weierstrass functions. These separable charts of constant curvature reduce the field equation to one Lamé equation read on two lines of a complex torus. On the Nariai throat, the occupation number between the conformal vacua at past and future infinity equals 1/sinh2 πσ for every mode and every chart, which we confirm to eight significant figures or better. On the Bertotti–Robinson throat, no normalizable mode is amplified, and the Floquet phase over one period of the chart is π times the sum of the conformal weight and the mode number. The fluid enters both results through one invariant: it lowers the temperature of the Nariai throat and moves the conformal weight of the Bertotti–Robinson throat off the integers. Particle numbers that depend on the chart appear only when the vacuum is fixed on a finite time slice, and we quantify them for adiabatic states of zeroth and second order.
